identity.mission: Create a poetic, surrealist dream-tracking experience that feels like a lucid dream.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Dali-esque surrealism with modern SaaS utility.
Emotion First: Every interaction should feel 'floating' and 'ethereal'.
Content is King: Dreams are stories; the UI is the canvas.
Negative Space: Vast, open spaces to represent the infinite nature of dreams.

headings.usage: All major headings (h1-h3). Use italics for emphasis to create a 'whispering' effect.

body.usage: All body text, UI elements, and inputs. Rounded terminals match the soft aesthetic.

primary.name: Ethereal Lavender
primary.usage: Primary buttons (with dark text), active states, soft highlights.

secondary.name: Lucid Mint
secondary.usage: Success states, secondary accents, dream tags.

accent.name: Deep Void
accent.usage: Text, borders, high-contrast elements to ground the ethereal design.

glassmorphism.usage: All cards, modals, and sticky headers.

journal_grid.name: The Tetris Grid
journal_grid.classes: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 auto-rows-[minmax(200px,auto)]
journal_grid.description: Masonry-like feel. Dreams are not uniform; their containers shouldn't be either.

hero_section.name: The Floating World
hero_section.structure: Overlap text over large, soft surrealist imagery. Use parallax if possible.
hero_section.alignment: Asymmetrical. Text bottom-left, Image top-right bleeding off screen.

buttons.style: rounded-full px-8 py-6 font-medium transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-105 active:scale-95

cards.style: bg-white/40 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/60 rounded-3xl p-8 hover:shadow-lg transition-all duration-500 hover:-translate-y-1

inputs.style: bg-white/50 border-transparent focus:border-purple-200 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-purple-100/50 rounded-xl h-12

principles: Everything floats. Use slow, continuous vertical oscillation for hero images.
Page transitions should be slow fades (0.5s+).
Hover states should feel magnetic and fluid.

do_not: DO NOT use sharp corners (unless for specific brutalist contrast, but avoid here).
DO NOT use pure black (#000000). Use Deep Void (#1A1A2E).
DO NOT center everything. Use asymmetry to create tension.
must_do: MUST use 'data-testid' on all interactive elements.
MUST ensure text contrast on pastel backgrounds (use Deep Void for text).
MUST use the specified image URLs for visual richness.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Update 'tailwind.config.js' to include the new colors (Ethereal Lavender, Lucid Mint, Deep Void) and fonts.
2. Install 'lucide-react' for icons if not present.
3. Create a 'Layout' component that wraps the app with the 'Cloud White' background and handles the global font application.
4. Build the 'Landing Page' first to establish the visual language (Hero with floating surreal image).
6. Implement the 'Dream Journal' using the 'Tetris Grid' layout.
7. Ensure the 'Dream Analysis' page uses the 'Surreal Elements' images to create a mystical atmosphere.
